# Universal Voice Creator Studio — NPC Lab Merge

This zipped folder merges the NPC Voice Lab roster/model/emotion system into the cleaner Voice Creator Studio layout.

## Entry point
Open `index.html`.

## What changed in this revision
- NPCs load from a scrollable left-side rack.
- The lab NPC objects are kept with their keys, initials, names, pronunciations, race, class, gender, alignment, biome, accent, model keys, repository assignment keys, samples, and bios.
- The slider schema now uses the clean user-facing names requested by the user: Voice Height, Speaking Speed, Expression Shape, Hesitations, Softness, Gruff Edge, Body / Depth, Speech Style, Vowel Flow, Consonant Bite, Mouth Shape, Nasal Color, Throat Depth, Speech Rhythm, Pause Space, Word Emphasis, Warmth, Clarity, Projection, Human Variation, and Accent Color.
- The influence controls now use the requested 0–100% schema: Race / Ancestry Influence, Gender Identity Influence, Personality Influence, Accent Strength / Remove Accent, Uploaded / Recorded Voice Influence, and Emotion Strength.
- Technical oscillator labels are no longer shown to the user. Internal synth texture is still auto-managed by the voice engine.
- Browser speech preview remains available, with Web Audio synth texture layered underneath.
- Edited MP3 export uses the provided backend endpoint and keeps the filename pattern `Firstname_Lastname-emotion.mp3`.
- The embedded repository voice stamp audio block from the NPC Lab was not copied into this merged build. Repository voice metadata is preserved for backend payloads.
- The code keeps the explicit safety layer: `own_voice`, `licensed_actor`, `public_domain_character_asset`, or `synthetic_original`; unknown asset types are blocked by default.

## Folders
- `css/` — studio layout and visual styling.
- `js/` — NPC lab data and merged studio controller.
- `data/` — JSON export of the bundled NPC/model data.
- `docs/` — original NPC Lab documentation plus merge notes.


## Latest merge pass

All prior NPC Voice Lab versions available in this task were merged into this Voice Creator Studio folder. The current app is `index.html`, with restored embedded repository voice stamps, searchable NPC rack, full sliders, repo-stamp preview, stop audio, safety-checked backend MP3 export, and archived legacy builds under `docs/legacy_versions/`.

## Wide Range Slider Revision

Updated 2026-06-25: the NPC voice editor now includes Deep Register, Musical Lilt, Air Texture, Harsh Edge, and Vocal Weight sliders. The local WAV renderer and export payloads use the `wide-impact-v3` parameter contract for much stronger low-end, gruffness, air, lilt, harshness, and vocal-weight changes. See `docs/WIDE_RANGE_SLIDER_REVISION.md`.
